rubric.why: Identifies genetics as a branch or study within biology.

rubric.why: Names the subject matter of genetics.
rubric.description: States that genetics deals with inheritance (heredity) and variation.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for mentioning inheritance or heredity and variation.

modelAnswer: Genetics is the branch of biology that deals with the study of inheritance (heredity) and variation.

items.followUp: What is the use of computers in bioinformatics?

rubric.description: Mentions the use or application of computers/information technology.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for referring to computers or information technology.

rubric.why: Specifies that bioinformatics is used to handle or study biological information.
rubric.description: Connects computer use with biological data or information.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for specifying biological data, information, or biomolecules.

modelAnswer: Bioinformatics is the use of computers and information technology to store, retrieve and analyse biological data.

items.followUp: State one difference between the cell membrane and the cell wall.

rubric.why: Gives a distinguishing feature of the primary cell wall.
rubric.description: States that the primary cell wall is thin or flexible and forms while the cell is growing.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for a correct feature or formation time of the primary cell wall.

rubric.why: Gives a distinguishing feature of the secondary cell wall.
rubric.description: States that the secondary cell wall is thicker or more rigid and forms after cell growth.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for a correct feature or formation time of the secondary cell wall.

modelAnswer: The primary cell wall is thin and flexible and is formed while the cell is growing.
The secondary cell wall is thicker and more rigid and is deposited inside the primary wall after cell growth.

items.followUp: Name the two main stages of the cell cycle.

rubric.why: Describes the cell cycle as an ordered series of events.
rubric.description: Defines the cell cycle as a series or sequence of events.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for describing it as a series or sequence of events.

rubric.why: Includes cell growth and division, the key processes of the cycle.
rubric.description: States that the events involve cell growth and division.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for mentioning cell growth and cell division.

modelAnswer: The cell cycle is the series of events in which a cell grows and divides.

items.followUp: What is the role of lysosomes in autolysis?

rubric.why: Explains how lysosomal enzymes become available during necrosis.
rubric.description: States that lysosomes burst or release their enzymes.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that lysosomes burst or release enzymes.

rubric.why: Explains the effect of the released enzymes on the cell.
rubric.description: States that the enzymes digest or break down the cell's components.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the enzymes digest or break down cell components.

modelAnswer: During necrosis, lysosomes burst and release digestive enzymes.
These enzymes digest the cell's components, causing the cell to break down.
